# White Cap Opens Distribution Center in Lower Nazareth Township

White Cap now employs 66 people at the former Stitch Fix warehouse in Lower Nazareth.

Aug. 11, 2026

— Jeff Ward, Lehigh Valley News Briefs

White Cap, a distributor of construction supplies and safety products, has opened a Bethlehem-area distribution center.

The Atlanta-based company is operating at 4770 Hanoverville Road in Lower Nazareth Township, formerly site of Stitch Fix, an online clothing retailer that closed in 2023. The 35-acre property is owned by Prologis, which has about 30 million square feet of warehouse space in the Lehigh Valley.

White Cap refers to that operation as its Bethlehem Enterprise Distribution Center. During its recent grand opening, White Cap donated $5,000 each to the Hecktown Volunteer Fire Company and Upper Nazareth Fire Department.

# White Cap Opens 2nd Enterprise Distribution Center in PA

 The facility supports 67 branches across 13 states amid a year of acquisitions and network expansion for the construction and safety products distributor. 

 Author 

- MDM Staff 

 Date 

- August 6, 2026 

Construction and safety supplies distributor White Cap celebrated the opening of its second Enterprise Distribution Center on Aug. 6 in Bethlehem, PA, adding nearly 481,000 square feet of distribution capacity to serve the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

The facility is White Cap’s first EDC in the eastern U.S. and follows the September 2025 opening of its first such center in Perris, CA. The Bethlehem location currently supports 67 White Cap branches across 13 states, including major markets such as New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, Baltimore and Washington, D.C. It employs 66 associates, with plans to grow beyond 70 as operations expand.

“Our Bethlehem EDC puts more of our broad product assortment closer to our customers’ job sites,” White Cap CEO Alan Sollenberger said. He added that the center is intended to improve delivery speed and reliability across some of the country’s busiest construction markets.

# White Cap Opens Pennsylvania Distribution Center to Expand Northeast Supply Chain

 August 6, 2026 

 

White Cap has opened a new Enterprise Distribution Center in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, expanding its logistics network with a nearly 481,000-square-foot facility designed to strengthen product availability and delivery speed for professional contractors across the Eastern United States.

The Bethlehem facility marks the distributor’s second Enterprise Distribution Center and its first serving the eastern region, representing a significant investment in the company’s national supply chain infrastructure. White Cap said the new operation will improve its ability to deliver specialty construction supplies and safety products to customers across some of the country’s most active construction markets.

Occupying approximately 140,000 square feet in a massive 1.2-million-square-foot facility, this new distribution center provides Spartan with the capacity to scale inventory and seamlessly support our customers’ evolving needs.
